candidate.answerReason: The three function values are 1, 3, and 6, which sum to 10.

methods.label: Apply the given rule
methods.explanation:
The average of two numbers is their sum divided by \(2\), so the definition gives \(\heartsuit(x)=(x+x^2)/2\). Substituting the three inputs,
\[
\heartsuit(1)=\frac{1+1}{2}=1,
\qquad
\heartsuit(2)=\frac{2+4}{2}=3,
\]
\[
\heartsuit(3)=\frac{3+9}{2}=6.
\]
Their sum is \(1+3+6=\boxed{10}\), choice \(\text{C}\).
